opportunities.name: NYSTAR Innovation Matching Grants
opportunities.summary: ONE WEEK WINDOW: opens 2nd Wed of Oct/Apr at 9am, closes the following Tue 5pm. Matches up to 50% of the federal award.
opportunities.eligibility: NY State small business, <=100 employees, applying for or holding a federal SBIR/STTR award

opportunities.name: Cornell CAT Grant
opportunities.summary: Not a solo apply -- needs a Cornell faculty co-PI with Vybe as the NY industry partner.
opportunities.eligibility: Cornell faculty PI applies; company partner must be a NY State for-profit

opportunities.name: AWS Activate
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Tiered -- the larger amounts generally require an accelerator or VC affiliation.

opportunities.name: Activate Fellowship
opportunities.summary: 2026 cohort closed Oct 2025. Next cycle typically opens ~October.
opportunities.eligibility: Scientists/engineers with 4+ years post-baccalaureate research or engineering experience

opportunities.name: America's Seed Fund -- NSF Project Pitch
opportunities.amount: gateway to $305K Phase I, up to $2M across phases
opportunities.summary: Rolling, ~2 pages. Mandatory gate before any NSF full proposal -- the actual first step.
opportunities.eligibility: US small business; no clinical claim required

opportunities.name: Berkeley SkyDeck
opportunities.summary: Six-month cohort, ~20 companies selected per batch.

opportunities.name: FuzeHub Jeff Lawrence Manufacturing Grants
opportunities.summary: 2026 round closed May 7. Next opens ~Apr 2027 -- same partner shape as Cornell CAT.
opportunities.eligibility: A NY nonprofit or university applies, partnered with a NY manufacturer

opportunities.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Straight conversion of credits into retained cash.
opportunities.eligibility: <5 years old, pre-Series A funding, not a prior GCP program participant

opportunities.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Start here before the Google and AWS tiers.
opportunities.eligibility: No funding required to apply -- the most accessible entry point of the three

opportunities.name: NIST MEP manufacturing voucher
opportunities.summary: Most state centers offer a free initial manufacturability assessment.
opportunities.eligibility: Routed through your state MEP center, not paid directly to the company

opportunities.name: NVIDIA Inception
opportunities.amount: free -- routes to $100K AWS + $100K DGX Cloud credits
opportunities.summary: Rolling, no equity, no fee. Typically a 1-4 week decision.
opportunities.eligibility: Incorporated, <10 years old, a website and at least one developer; no revenue required

opportunities.name: NY Ventures Pre-Seed & Seed Matching Fund
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Equity investment, not a grant -- matched against qualified private investment.
opportunities.eligibility: NY-registered, <$2M dilutive raised to date, >=1 C-suite employee in-state

opportunities.name: NYS SSBCI Technical Assistance
opportunities.amount: free legal, accounting and financial advising
opportunities.summary: Not cash -- free professional services. Could cover the SDK-licensing and HIPAA structuring work.
opportunities.eligibility: NY very small business (<10 employees) or SEDI-owned (<100 employees)

opportunities.name: Rev: Ithaca Prototyping Hardware Accelerator
opportunities.summary: 10-week cohort with a MedTech track. Devices-for-research-access shape.
